backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as the backend entry point with no implemented functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting a fix for the HeroSection 'Contact Sales' CTA button to render human-readable translated labels instead of raw translation keys across English, Hindi, and Marathi.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of frontend source files to short summaries describing each component's purpose and notable recent changes.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS file defining OKLCH CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens, including background, foreground, border, chart, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app, mounting the root div and loading the main TypeScript module for the True Origin Company LLP site.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application shell that sets up TanStack Router routes, a responsive NavBar with language selector and smooth-scroll nav links, and renders all page-level components including legal and export certification pages.
frontend/src/components/AboutSection.tsx: About section component that renders a translated checklist, operations list, vision/mission cards, and stats using the `useLanguage` hook for multi-language support.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact section with an info panel showing address, phone, and two mailto email links, plus a controlled enquiry form with submission feedback, all text translated via `useLanguage`.
frontend/src/components/ExportCargoSecti: Export cargo section displaying a cargo ship image and three translated highlight cards (documentation, packaging, global reach) using the `useLanguage` hook.
frontend/src/components/ExportCertificat: Renders a full export certification page displaying certifications (APEDA, FSSAI, etc.), quality control steps, and product-specific packaging/documentation details using i18n keys.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer with brand logo, contact info, quick navigation links (with smooth-scroll support across routes), and legal/social links.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-screen hero section with a background image, overlay, headline, two CTA buttons (export specs link and contact sales scroll), and a scroll-down indicator.
frontend/src/components/LanguageSelector: Dropdown component for switching between English, Hindi, and Marathi using the LanguageContext, with styling that adapts based on scroll state.
frontend/src/components/PrivacyPolicyPag: Displays the privacy policy with a header, numbered sections sourced from i18n translations, and a contact callout linking to the company email.
Products section showcasing four export products (moringa, curry leaves, vegetables, custom sourcing) in a grid with images, icons, and a farm image gallery.
frontend/src/components/QualityComplianc: Quality and compliance section listing six export documentation types in a grid, with introductory text and a CTA button linking to the export certification page.
frontend/src/components/SocialMediaSecti: Renders a social media section with three placeholder video cards (marked 'Coming Soon') and Instagram/YouTube icon links, using i18n keys for all text content.
frontend/src/components/TermsAndConditio: Displays a styled Terms and Conditions page with eight translated sections, a back-to-home link, and a contact email callout at the bottom.
frontend/src/contexts/LanguageContext.ts: Provides a React context for language switching (en/hi/mr) with a translation lookup function that falls back to English or the raw key.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (anonymous or authenticated) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/clear functions and status flags for use throughout the app.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, defines CSS custom properties for the design system (colors, radius, etc.) with light/dark variants, and applies Tailwind base/component/utility layers.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/translations/translations.t: Exports a nested translations object keyed by language code (en, hi, mr) containing all UI string keys for the application.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom brand colors (deepEmerald, softGold, cream, forest, gold), Playfair Display and Poppins font families, custom shadows, and animation keyframes.
project_state.json: Tracks the current state (version 39) of the TrueOrigin Exports website project, including architectural notes, known rendering/UI bugs, color palette, copy, and feature history for a static agricultural export marketing site.
